evidence.note: The upper drawer between the refrigerator and stove is fully closed.
A hand is pulling the drawer outward and its contents become visible.
The grocery-filled drawer is clearly open.
The same drawer remains fully extended.
A hand pushes the drawer inward.
The drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Upper white grocery drawer between the refrigerator and stove

evidence.note: Both wooden cabinet leaves above the range hood are closed.
A hand begins pulling the viewer-left cabinet leaf outward.
The viewer-left leaf is open while the other leaf remains closed.
The viewer-left leaf remains open.
The viewer-left leaf appears closed while the viewer-right leaf is still projecting outward.

events.object_description: Viewer-left wooden cabinet door above the range hood

evidence.note: The viewer-right cabinet leaf remains closed after the left leaf has opened.
The user begins manipulating the second cabinet leaf.
The viewer-right leaf is swinging outward.
Both cabinet leaves are clearly open.
The viewer-right leaf is still projecting outward after the other leaf has closed.
Both cabinet fronts are closed.

events.object_description: Viewer-right wooden cabinet door above the range hood

evidence.note: The upper drawer to the right of the stove is closed and a hand reaches its handle.
The drawer is being pulled outward, exposing foil boxes, utensils, and cloths.
The drawer is clearly open.
The same drawer remains extended.
A hand pushes the drawer shut and the front is nearly flush.
The drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Upper white utensil-and-wrap drawer to the right of the stove, beneath the countertop appliance

notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. Four distinct movable parts are counted: two drawers and the two independently manipulated leaves of the cabinet above the range hood. The two cabinet closing times are approximate because both closures occur within the short t=544 to t=560 interval and perspective partially obscures the first closure.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow galley kitchen, opens and closes a grocery drawer beside the stove, independently opens and closes both doors of the cabinet above the range hood, and then opens and closes a utensil-and-wrap drawer on the opposite side of the stove.
